description: List the video templates create_video can render, with what each one is for, the fields it reads and the ones it cannot do without, plus the canvases (9:16, 1:1, 16:9) and what a video and a screenshot cost in credits. Reads a fixed catalogue; nothing is created. Call it once before the first create_video of a conversation, then choose the template whose `when` matches what the user asked for. Every template takes the same flat fields — headline, subheadline, body, shots, features, cta, stat — and ignores the ones it does not use; the brand (name, tagline, icon, accent colour) is filled in from the workspace unless overridden.
name: list_video_templates
title: List video templates
